def test_compare():
    # identical -> all zeros
    assert compare([1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3]) == [0, 0, 0]

    # general case
    assert compare([10, 20, 30], [8, 25, 30]) == [2, 5, 0]

    # order doesn't matter due to abs
    assert compare([3], [5]) == [2]
    assert compare([5], [3]) == [2]

    # negatives
    assert compare([-1, -5], [2, 3]) == [3, 8]

    # floats
    assert compare([1.5, 2.0], [1.0, 2.5]) == [0.5, 0.5]

    # empty
    assert compare([], []) == []
    assert compare([], [1, 2]) == []

    # different lengths -> zip truncates to shortest
    assert compare([1, 2, 3], [1, 2]) == [0, 0]
